teams.heading: Fiji sit bottom of the log following third consecutive defeat
teams.body: Fiji sit bottom of the 12-team log after three rounds, having suffered a 17-33 defeat against Scotland in their last outing. The team have conceded 145 points across their three matches. They have scored 49 points in that same period — leaving them with a points difference of minus 96. This current run sits in stark contrast to the heights of 2023, when the Flying Fijians achieved their best world ranking of No. 7.

Both players joined Sale Sharks this summer after spells in France, restoring their eligibility for the upcoming autumn series. teams.heading: Former Ireland international Brian Smith dies aged 59 following cancer battle
teams.body: The rugby community is mourning former Ireland and Australia international Brian Smith, who has passed away aged 59 following a battle with cancer. A versatile half-back, Smith earned nine caps for Ireland between 1989 and 1991 after previously representing the Wallabies six times. Following a career that spanned both union and league, he transitioned into coaching and served as an England assistant coach. Prop Angus Bell, who was mentored by Smith at school level, paid tribute to the Queensland native as an “avid rugby person.”

lead.why: The death of a dual-international who played for and coached Ireland is today's most significant and corroborated story.

teams.heading: Argentina XV to face England A in November fixture at Bath
teams.body: The Argentina XV have confirmed a non-capped tour match against England 'A', scheduled for 6 November at the Recreation Ground in Bath. The match marks the first meeting between the two nations' secondary sides in nearly two decades, following the Argentina XV's recent second-place finish in the 2026 Americas Rugby Championship. teams.heading: Carter Gordon faces two months out after suffering leg fracture
teams.body: The Wallabies are set to be without first-choice flyhalf Carter Gordon for the upcoming Test against South Africa and the Bledisloe Cup series. Scans have confirmed a leg fracture sustained during the draw against Argentina, forcing a two-month recovery period. While there is optimism the 25-year-old could return for the England tour, Les Kiss must now evaluate his options. Ben Donaldson remains in the frame, while the impending return of Tom Lynagh offers an alternative during this critical period.

teams.heading: Japan Women retain top spot in Asia Rugby Emirates Sevens Series
teams.body: The Japan women’s sevens side successfully defended their title at the opening leg of the Asia Rugby Emirates Sevens Series in Suzhou, China. The result marks a strong start to the season for the Sakura 7s, maintaining their status as the dominant force in the region while their continental opponents continue to push for parity.

teams.heading: Dave Rennie prepares rotation for final Test after injury-hit Soweto loss
teams.body: Coach Dave Rennie will inject fresh energy into his side for Saturday’s series finale in Baltimore, with changes planned despite a depleted squad. New Zealand travel to the United States trailing the Springboks 2-1 after their defeat in Soweto. The selection process faces added complexity following injuries to captain Ardie Savea, Luke Jacobson and Quinn Tupaea. Rennie noted that the team would have rotated regardless of the previous result, stating, “We sort of always thought we would make changes in the fourth Test.”

teams.heading: Morné van den Berg to start as Boks finalise series plans
teams.body: Morné van den Berg will start at scrum-half in the series decider against the All Blacks, with Rassie Erasmus confirming the Lions playmaker earns his spot after a successful cameo in the third Test. Van den Berg replaces Cobus Reinach in the starting XV, while Damian Willemse returns to the side to replace the injured Cheslin Kolbe. Erasmus noted: "We think he deserves a start," adding that the scrum-half's recovery and impact off the bench have been impressive.

lead.why: The promotion of Morné van den Berg for the series decider is the most significant selection news reported in the current cycle.
